issue.title: GET_AVB_INFO on a non-AVB_INTERFACE descriptor must answer NOT_SUPPORTED (Table 7-141 status 11), not NOT_IMPLEMENTED (revert #182's status)
issue.body:
**GET_AVB_INFO on a descriptor other than AVB_INTERFACE must answer NOT_SUPPORTED, not NOT_IMPLEMENTED.** This reverses the status choice of PR #182 (#177).

**Clauses:**
- IEEE 1722.1-2021 Table 7-141 defines status 1, NOT_IMPLEMENTED, as "The ATDECC Entity does not support the command type". Status 11, NOT_SUPPORTED, is "The command is implemented but the target of the command is not supported".
- Milan v1.2 5.4.2.23 requires the PAAD-AE to implement GET_AVB_INFO. The command type is therefore implemented, and only the target (descriptor_type other than AVB_INTERFACE, 7.4.40.1) is unsupported.
- IEEE 1722.1-2021 9.3.5.3.3 ("Any command that is received and not implemented shall be responded to with ... NOT_IMPLEMENTED") applies to command types the entity does not implement. It does not apply to an implemented command aimed at the wrong descriptor type.
- Milan v1.2 uses NOT_SUPPORTED the same way for implemented commands on unsupported targets: 5.4.2.2 (LOCK_ENTITY on a descriptor other than ENTITY) and 5.4.2.9 (SET_STREAM_INFO on a Stream Input).

**Required:**
- The wrong-type GET_AVB_INFO answers NOT_SUPPORTED, echoed at its own length.
- An AVB_INTERFACE index that does not exist still answers NO_SUCH_DESCRIPTOR, and a short command still answers BAD_ARGUMENTS.
- Update the command model, F06.14, `tb/aecp_cmds/decode.json` and the compliance review entry (section 8, item 12), with the V5 rows expecting status 11.

Found by the manager's ruling on a bench run of the adopted image (milan-fpga dev a032c6d6, processor 93fb0b2d).
